message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I would not call this ECG normal.** From the image, I see:

- A fast, fairly regular rhythm, approximately **150–160 beats/minute**.
- A conduction pattern suggesting **right bundle branch block**, with associated ST/T-wave changes.
- Possible **atrial flutter with 2:1 conduction**, although the rhythm needs confirmation on the original tracing. This can produce a regular heart rate around 150. [Clinical reference](https://www.merckmanuals.com/en-ca/professional/cardiovascular-disorders/specific-cardiac-arrhythmias/atrial-flutter)

An image alone cannot establish the diagnosis or rule out a heart attack.

**If this is your current ECG and your heart rate remains this fast at rest, seek urgent medical assessment today.** If you have chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting, or severe dizziness, call emergency services now and don’t drive yourself.

Was this recorded at rest, and are you having any symptoms now?
